# dokploy_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Dokploy API Key. Note: This resource requires email/password authentication.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the API key.
- `organization_id` (String) The Organization ID to associate with this API key.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the API key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The generated API Key. This is only available on creation.
